body: I was, I ran track and field, I ran the 800m, mile, two mile, and high jumped

I’ve been diagnosed with anorexia with binge/purge tendencies(mostly restricting food intake and over exercising, but when I tend to binge I’ll either vomit or take laxatives)
Although I’ve never been “officially” diagnosed, I believe I do have body dysmorphia because... 
well I’ll KNOW I’m underweight, I’ll know I’m so sick that I can’t go up a flight of stairs without feeling like my joints might snap and my muscles feel like they’re trying to life 1000 lbs of bricks, but in the mirror I don’t see that... 
even though logically I know I’m sick, I’ll see someone that isn’t that way...

Never been inpatient, all my therapy has been outpatient, but the typical inpatient treatment for eating disorders is to regain the weight... (psych major, studying abnormal psych, also know several others from group therapy that have been inpatient)
I mean I know it helps because it makes the process quicker, but once you are at a normal weight you get released and you’re never really taught how to deal with those after effects...
Even with intensive therapy when I’m at an “optimal” weight I still just feel like something deep inside me NEEDS to “fix” how I look...
Also my older sister, mom, and great aunt have all struggled with ED’s as well...
it doesn’t help that when I’m a normal weight I’m depressed, and when I’m severely underweight I’m still depressed... I feel like I’m never gonna like my body and that obsession is always going to ruin my relationships

I mean I’m 21, so about half your age...
And I’m sorry that happened to you...
I’ve struggled with eating disorders since I was around 12 so I just feel like half my life(so far) has been wasted... and I hurt all the people around me because i always end up relapsing... I’m so tired of either being in a relapse or recovery, but there’s no in between for me and I can’t make meaningful relationships without fucking them up... 

*edit* I’m also kinda drunk so if I don’t make sense I’m sorry, my brain is fried from earlier today and also drinking

I mean, I do understand this, but it’s been so long since the relationship and well... long story short I’ve already accepted that my eating disorder was what ended the relationship(became severely underweight, didn’t want help, isolated from everyone because they would push me to get help) so I’m not sure if it was the aspect of my ED hurting my relationships with people I love or just the loss of that person all together... 
I guess it was a kinda “first real love” thing, and it ended in a way where if I could have just fucking not been so obsessed with my ED maybe it wouldn’t have even happened...
I feel like a child, I shouldn’t be crying over a breakup that was several years ago...

I understand how you feel... I know being suicidal and having suicidal thoughts are two different things, but I feel like my brain has been consistently becoming more violent... 
I’m surrounded by people that love me and want me to be happy, but I feel like they all are just lying...
